articles.title: Sharmila Dhankar wins historic gold as India bags 6 medals on CWG Day 5
articles.summary: India demonstrated its strongest performance at the Commonwealth Games 2026, securing six medals on Day 5, bringing the total to 10. A significant highlight was Sharmila Dhankar setting a new national record. This impressive display underscores India's growing sporting prowess and competitive spirit on an international stage, inspiring national pride and ambition.

articles.title: Australia’s ‘World-First’ Data Center Rules Face First Hurdle
articles.summary: Australian PM Anthony Albanese's proposed world-first environmental and energy controls for the nation's A$150 billion data center pipeline face their initial test this Tuesday. These regulations aim to curb the substantial environmental impact and high energy consumption of data centers, showcasing Australia's proactive approach to sustainable technology development. This initiative could set a global precedent.

articles.title: gs1belu-mpm-download-mcp added to PyPI
articles.summary: This unofficial community project emphasizes its complete independence, explicitly stating no affiliation, endorsement, or support from GS1. The disclaimer highlights that 'GS1' and 'My Product Manager' are proprietary, reinforcing the project's status as a distinct, community-driven initiative. This clarity ensures users understand its grassroots origins and lack of corporate backing.
